theorem: The twenty-four positive child-basis preparations and child-resolving effects determine every transition entry of exp(-t A_tilde). The signed four-count contrast equals S*exp(-t A_tilde)S=exp(-tB), without requiring an unphysical negative preparation. With calibrated t and spectrum in the principal-log domain, B=-(1/t)log(exp(-tB)) is reconstructed. The frozen schema separates provider, registrar, and analyst and supports a pre-registered holdout.
